# authwise_access_roles (Data Source)

A role in an audience's Access catalog. The id is the role's own name; its permissions are managed by `authwise_access_role_access_permissions`. This data source lists every one under a parent.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `audience_id` (String) Parent identifier `audience_id`; overrides the provider default.
- `issuer_id` (String) Parent identifier `issuer_id`; overrides the provider default.
- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default.

### Read-Only

- `access_roles` (Attributes List) Every access_role under the parent, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access_roles))

<a id="nestedatt--access_roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access_roles`

Read-Only:

- `access_role_id` (String) Caller-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`.
- `description` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `name` (String) Full resource name.
